title: Unit Event — Perspective for Smile — Episode3 Something's Missing

meta.Event Outline: Wonderlands×Showtime has finished training with Shunmeiza, and is set to study stage combat with the Mikazukigumi troupe. How will Emu and the others fare on this new, intensely physical stage?!

rows.Speaker: Mikazukigumi Member A
rows.Line: Alright, let's try doing the showdown scene with Benkei at the Gojo Bridge again!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Ready when you are!
I'm gonna dodge all of your attacks!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Big words!
Then, I'm going to throw everything I have at you!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (He goes diagonally first, so I need to dodge by squatting... And then I need to jump backwards!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Next, he's gonna start jabbing at me really fast, so I need to twist to my right and...)

rows.Speaker: Mikazukigumi Member A
rows.Line:
*Nod*
You two are doing great.
You've basically got that sequence down pat.

rows.Speaker: Mikazukigumi Member A
rows.Line:
Which brings me to the finer details...
Tenma, you need to wield your naginata using your feet more instead of just your arms!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Got it! I'll try improving my footwork.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, Mr. Kijima!
You guys came too, Nene, Rui...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We were practicing over there when we got called over. It's apparently time to show the results of today's practice.

rows.Speaker: Mikazukigumi Members
rows.Line:
They should be.
They've already been able to memorize the entire fight.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line:
Really?! That's great!
In that case, please begin once you're ready.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh, then... Can I start us off?
I wanna go while everything's still fresh in my head.

rows.Speaker: Mikazukigumi Members
rows.Line: “Over eight hundred years ago, following the defeat of Minamoto no Yoshimoto at the hands of Taira no Kiyomori, the children of Yoshimoto found themselves in mortal danger.”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (She bravely protects her children by fighting off the agents of the Taira clan who keep pursuing them.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
“Huff... Huff... Huff...
The Taira clan's henchmen are already here.”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
“These children must live on...
They are to carry the Minamoto clan forward. The line must not be extinguished...”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “I was born into a family of warriors. If I must wield a blade to defend these children, then I shall...!”

rows.Speaker: Mikazukigumi Members
rows.Line:
“Your determination is admirable!
Unfortunately, the Minamoto clan must end here! Prepare yourself!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
He's so light on his feet...!
He really feels like Kurama Tengu. He's captured how powerful Ushiwakamaru's teacher is.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: That isn't how I was taught to wield a sword. But I guess a tengu wouldn't use one the same way a human would...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: This is so cool! Rui looks like he's flying!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
“Foolish humans...
Such is your punishment for desecrating these mountains with your filthy footprints...”

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: Nice work! Now, last but not least...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We'll be doing the scene where Ushiwakamaru and Benkei face off at the Gojo Bridge!

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line:
Ah, the climax of this play.
Alright, start once you both feel ready...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Don't worry! You've got a good idea of what Ushiwakamaru's like...!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (The Ushiwakamaru from this story loves to have fun, so it's easy for him to forget about what he was doing whenever he finds something that really excites him...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (All that's left is for me to really immerse myself...!)

rows.Speaker: Mikazukigumi Members
rows.Line: “Time would then pass... By the time Ushiwakamaru had turned fifteen, he'd become a warrior in his own right. However, he would also have to choose his path moving forward...”

rows.Speaker: Mikazukigumi Members
rows.Line: “Meanwhile, in Kyoto, word of a crazed monk attacking people night after night and robbing them of their swords would begin spreading.”

rows.Speaker: Mikazukigumi Members
rows.Line: “And on this fateful night, he would wait at his usual bridge to run into none other than...”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
(So it begins.
I'm looking forward to seeing how they move during this scene.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (From what I remember, Ushiwakamaru has to keep dodging Benkei's attacks...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Which leaves such a big impression on Benkei that he feels he can't win and decides to pledge his services to Ushiwakamaru...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(They can't just recite their lines.
They have to also move in a way that makes their characters feel true to life.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “One last sword to complete my collection of a thousand! Tonight, my vow comes to fruition...!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
“Drop your katana and leave this place!
Only then shall I spare your life!”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
“Oh, have you no manners?
Put away that dreadful thing and look up to the sky.”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: “See how beautiful the moon is tonight?”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
“What nonsense do you speak?!
If you refuse to surrender, then it is my naginata you shall face...!”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(Th-That was amazing...
Tsukasa's one thing, but Emu too... She flew so high while jumping backwards...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
“Quit fooling around!
You are a mere child... But if you are going to call yourself a warrior, then unsheathe your katana and fight me!”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: “Saying that only makes me want to take you even less seriously. Oh, missed me... Missed again...”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Ushiwakamaru slips behind Benkei, takes out his fan and forces his opponent to his knees in shock... The decisive moment.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (It's supposed to be an epic duel, but to think that they were able to polish it into something so spectacular in such a short amount of time...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I'm glad I chose Emu to be our Ushiwakamaru. She's captured his free-spirited nature marvelously.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Something feels a bit off for some reason...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
That's it!
Thank you all very much!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
(Yes...!
That felt like our best attempt of the day!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I even nailed that big jump I spent so much time practicing!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I bet Mr. Kijima and the others are gonna be so...)

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: I wasn't expecting to see such a high-quality first attempt. Naturally, there are things I'd like to teach you moving forward, but you've shown me plenty today...!

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: I was particularly impressed by the showdown between Ushiwakamaru and Benkei in the end there. Your acrobatics were stunning, Otori!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Really...?!
Hehe. Thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: W-Wait, do you mean we need to improve the way we move during our sword fight?

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line:
No, that's not what I'm talking about...
Obviously, it's important to put on a compelling sword fight. That can be achieved through practice.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: What I'm trying to say is that there's something missing from your acting...

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: It might be easier to just show you an example.
